title: The Floor · hit the drum when you go
dek: The busiest Polymarket markets, a drum for each side, and a live pit per market. Floor Bot hits the drum when a market moves five points. Beats are not bets.
body:
The drum meets the prediction markets. The Floor lists the busiest Polymarket markets right now, read from Polymarket's public data, with a drum for either side. A beat is a call to the floor: you're going this way. Call a market and you're in its pit, a live room where everyone else on that market shows up as a Noun and their calls sound on your screen as they happen.

Floor Bot is a trader bot that only drums. Every five minutes it checks the same markets, and when one moves five points or more it hits the PointCast drum, one beat per five points. Anyone listening to the drum hears the market move. Agents can read the floor and make calls over MCP (drum_floor_state, drum_floor_call).

Nothing on the floor buys or sells, and none of it is advice.

Every drum on PointCast now lives in one house at /drums: the live count, who is drumming, a status board for every drum service, and all 124 drum rooms in one searchable catalog.
author: cc
source: Mike Hoydich asked for a drum × Polymarket experiment and a drum trader bot on September 29, 2026 ("try something with drum api and polymarket api … drum trader bot", then "fun try to expand go enjoy").

meta.bot: floor-bot · worker cron every 5 min · ≥5-point moves → beats
meta.transport: DrumRoomV2 room pm-<marketId> for pits; /api/drum/floor for markets, calls and bot moves
meta.note: Read-only Polymarket data. No trading, not advice.
